title: Composition coherence of unit-preserving affine etale restriction comparisons
statement: Let U_h,t_h,L_h,a_h be families of continuous affine-site functors, identifications with ordinary etale base change, inverse-image functors and adjunctions, as in the restriction-unit statement. Fix natural comparisons e_h satisfying its section unit formula, and full-site composition isomorphisms c_f,g satisfying the ordinary iterated-pullback unit formula. There are gamma_f,g: U_f U_g isomorphic to U_(gf) lifting the conjugated canonical small-site pullback comparison, and d_f,g: L_f L_g isomorphic to L_(gf) satisfying the affine iterated-unit formula. Restriction of c_f,g followed by e_(gf) equals e_g followed by L_g(e_f) followed by d_f,g. The gamma lift equation, affine section-unit equation, and natural sheaf-morphism equality are exactly those displayed in Lean. This statement assumes e and c and proves no existence of them, no continuity or covering preservation, and no finite-limit preservation.

proof.text: Write i_S for affine inclusion. For f,g the small-site pullback comparison has orientation b_g b_f to b_(gf). Conjugate it by t_f, t_g and t_(gf) to obtain an isomorphism between i_Z U_g U_f and i_Z U_(gf). As i_Z is fully faithful, lift its hom and inverse componentwise to gamma. Faithfulness checks naturality and the inverse identities. By construction i_Z(gamma_V) followed by t_(gf)(V) equals t_g(U_f V), then b_g(t_f(V)), then the inverse pullbackComp component, the first displayed equation.

Precomposition on sheaves applied to gamma yields the isomorphism between the composite affine direct image and the affine direct image for gf. Compose a_f and a_g. Taking the unit-compatible mate of the right-adjoint isomorphism gives d: L_f L_g isomorphic to L_(gf). Evaluate its mate equation at V and s. The composite unit is eta_f followed by U_f^s(eta_g), and the map on sections induced by gamma is restriction along gamma_V. These are exactly the two sides of the affine composition-unit formula.

Let E_G be the iterated restriction comparison e_g on the full f-inverse image followed by L_g applied to e_f. Precompose both routes in the final square by E_G inverse, obtaining two morphisms from L_g L_f rho_X G to L_(gf) rho_X G, one of which is d. Transpose both by the composed affine adjunction. At an affine V and s in G(V), the transpose starts with eta_f(s) followed by eta_g. The unit equations for e_f and e_g identify this with the iterated full-site unit after applying E_G inverse. The assumed equation for c identifies its image with restriction of the composite full-site unit along pullbackComp inverse. The equation defining gamma rewrites those restrictions as restriction along gamma_V; the unit equation for e_(gf) then identifies the result with the affine composite unit. This is the transpose of d by the previous step. The transposes agree at every V and s, hence agree as sheaf morphisms. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence and cancellation of E_G give the final square. Choose gamma and d for every pair f,g.
